nodes.label: Decision: FastAPI over ASP.NET Core
nodes.rationale: Decisive factor was the team's prior Python experience and none in C#/.NET, under a part-time Oct 2026-Feb 2027 timeline that did not allow learning a new language/framework; FastAPI's automatic /docs documentation also proved useful to validate the API contract with the frontend before each integration.

nodes.label: Decision: React + TypeScript + Vite + Leaflet
nodes.rationale: React+TypeScript chosen as the most common pairing for statically-typed interactive web interfaces; Vite for its fast dev server and because it is the default choice for new React projects; Leaflet+OpenStreetMap as the most-used free/open option for interactive web maps, with no licensing cost.

nodes.label: Decision: PostgreSQL + PostGIS over MySQL/SQL Server
nodes.norm_label: decision: postgresql + postgis over mysql/sql server
nodes.rationale: PostGIS is the most mature open-source geospatial extension (ST_Distance, ST_DWithin, GiST spatial indexes); georeferencing utentes and computing distances is central to the project; the postgis/postgis Docker image is ready-made; SQL Server implies licensing and a heavier image, MySQL has more limited spatial functions.
